name: BooKoo Motto 80 Grinder
author: Roy Ackerman
description: Motto 80 burr-gap observations, RPM control and device settings over Bluetooth. Requires firmware v1.2.19.0820 or later. Physical grind adjustment is manual.

PacketTimeoutMs.label: Grinder notification timeout (milliseconds)
PacketTimeoutMs.description: Reports a silent data channel to Decaid. Default 5000; integer 1000 to 10000. The grinder normally reports five times per second.
